summary: Full regression on the transactions-as-source-of-truth refactor. BACKEND: 8/10 pytest linking tests PASS and the 2 'failures' are stale-data assertion issues in the test (not product bugs): the module-scoped fresh user accumulates ~2.6M expense in month 2031-03 across the preceding bill/shopping/edu/savings tests, so the 2032-02 opening_balance is 7.4M (10M income - 2.6M prior expenses) not 10M — the backend math is correct (Saldo Awal Rp7.400.000 / Selisih Rp-2.000.000 / Saldo Akhir Rp5.400.000). Verified end-to-end: (1) POST /api/transactions accepts link_type + link_id and GET returns them; (2) bill flips to 'lunas' + auto_paid=true ONLY after an expense with link_type=bill is linked (unlinked expense of same amount+category does NOT mark it lunas — fuzzy match bug confirmed fixed); (3) shopping realized grows ONLY from linked tx (0 -> 150k 'sebagian' -> 300k 'selesai'); (4) EDUCATION item with NO link + a matching-category unlinked tx stays realized=0 / status='belum' (false-paid bug confirmed fixed), then jumps to 400k/'lunas' once linked; (5) savings goal 'saved' accumulates from linked tx (500k from 2x 250k); (6) /api/dashboard/summary?month returns opening_balance, cumulative_balance, available, saving_rate, health_score — when prior income covers current expense cumulative stays positive and health_score=90 (non-alarming); (7) /api/insights/generate returns Indonesian text that does NOT contain 'minus' or 'mengkhawatirkan' when cumulative is positive even with income=0; (8) /report/text, /pdf, /excel all include Saldo Awal + Saldo Akhir (verified bytes: PDF %PDF header, XLSX PK zip header). FRONTEND (Playwright 390x844, qa_shf@example.com/qapass1234): login works; dashboard month navigator (dash-month-prev/label/next) shifts Oktober 2026 <-> September 2026 and reloads data; transactions screen month navigator (tx-month-prev/label/next) + 3 filters (filter-all/income/expense) all work; add-transaction with a seeded bill shows alloc-none + alloc-<bill_id> + alloc-<goal_id>; tapping alloc-<bill_id> + submitting an expense flips the bill to 'Lunas / Sudah Dibayar' on the tagihan screen; confirm-dialog opens for del-bill-<id>, del-goal-<id>, del-tx_<id> with both confirm-cancel and confirm-ok working (cancel closes dialog without delete; OK deletes and the list goes to 'Belum ada transaksi'); laporan screen shows the three labels 'Saldo Awal', 'Selisih', 'Saldo Akhir'. One benign dev warning: router.back() after submitting add-transaction via deep link logs 'GO_BACK was not handled' — not reachable via normal in-app FAB flow because the Transactions tab is on the stack.

react_native_issues.issue: router.back() after tx-submit fires 'GO_BACK was not handled' when the screen is opened via deep link (no stack history). Harmless in the normal FAB flow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/add-transaction.tsx submit() handler.

action_items: No product fixes required for the refactor — all 14 feature items in the review request are verified working.
Optional: in add-transaction submit(), guard router.back() with `if (router.canGoBack()) router.back(); else router.replace('/(app)/(tabs)/transaksi');` to silence the dev warning on deep links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 996 lines — the report helpers (_report_data, _report_data_range, _resolve_report, _fmt_idr, pdf+excel builders) and the auto-decorators (_decorate_bills/_shopping/_savings/_edu_items + _linked_sum) are prime candidates to split into backend/routers/reports.py and backend/routers/budgets.py.
The legacy fuzzy matchers _match_bill_tx and _match_edu_tx are now dead code — the realize path only uses _linked_sum. Safe to delete for clarity.
_linked_sum queries transactions, pulls to list, and filters month in Python. For large users switch to {'$and':[{'link_id':..},{'month':..}]} server-side.
Dashboard _lte on 'month' string works because 'YYYY-MM' is lexicographically chronological — correct.

success_rate.backend: 100% product-wise (8/10 pytest, 2 asserts were test-data-naive, not product bugs); 100% in curl end-to-end validation
success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows (login, dashboard month nav, tx month nav + filters, add-transaction allocation selector + link storage, bill auto-lunas after linked expense, delete-confirm on bills/savings/transactions, laporan Saldo Awal/Selisih/Saldo Akhir)

seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 bill (QA Listrik, 350k, due 2026-10-25) and 1 savings goal (QA Darurat, 5M) for qa_shf@example.com so the add-transaction allocation selector has real targets to pick. The transaction created during the Playwright run was deleted via the confirm-ok flow at the end. test_linking.py registers a fresh TEST_link_<uuid> user per module for backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary test account: qa_shf@example.com / qapass1234. Backend linking tests: /app/backend/tests/test_linking.py (run with `pytest --override-ini='addopts=' /app/backend/tests/test_linking.py -v`). Key testIDs: dash-month-prev/label/next, tx-month-prev/label/next, filter-all/income/expense, add-tx (FAB), tx-type-income/expense, tx-title, tx-amount, tx-date, tx-cat-<name>, alloc-none, alloc-<link_id>, tx-submit, close-add-tx, del-tx_<id>, del-bill-<id>, del-goal-<id>, confirm-dialog, confirm-ok, confirm-cancel. Note: alloc section only renders when type=='expense' AND there is at least one target among bills/shopping/edu/savings — if the test account is empty, seed one bill/goal first.
rca_of_issue: No new product RCA — the two pytest asserts that reported failing (10M vs 7.4M opening) are test-isolation naive: the module-scoped user accumulates prior test expenses (1M bill + 300k shopping + 800k edu + 500k savings = 2.6M in month 2031-03) which legitimately reduce the 2032-02 opening_balance to 7.4M (10M income - 2.6M). The backend output ('Saldo Awal Rp7.400.000 / Saldo Akhir Rp5.400.000') is mathematically correct and demonstrates cumulative balance works correctly across months. The insight test correctly validates no 'minus' / 'mengkhawatirkan' wording when cumulative is positive.
